divisions.name: Harness Core
divisions.purpose: Owns the plugin spine: loader, session log, agent loop, tools, and the capability seams every other division stands on.

divisions.name: Proving Ground
divisions.purpose: Runs every licensed route against the environment suite in shifts, with repetitions, seeds, and frozen paired experiments.

divisions.name: Verification
divisions.purpose: Executes the checks nobody self-reports, records the read-barrier census, and issues the certificate a release depends on.

divisions.name: Judging
divisions.purpose: Scores contested work against a frozen rubric, one lens per judge, and records the dissent alongside the verdict.

divisions.name: Curation and Data
divisions.purpose: Turns persisted sessions into exports that respect their recorded data-use terms, with redaction before anything leaves.

divisions.name: Program Departments
divisions.purpose: Splits one client deliverable into department goals on their own worktrees, then releases only on a certificate of the merged head.

divisions.name: Code Safety
divisions.purpose: Six departments read a target repository in parallel and place every finding on the line of code that carries it.

divisions.name: Knowledge
divisions.purpose: Keeps the packs, skills, and postmortems that every other division reads before it starts, under keep-or-retire review.

divisions.name: Governance
divisions.purpose: Gates the five transitions that never complete without a recorded signature, and routes incidents away from the blog.

divisions.name: Observatory
divisions.purpose: Folds persisted logs into the rows the deck shows, and never blends across isolation, held-out flag, or executor.
